# AGENTS.md for Empirical Legal Scholars

> A general AGENTS.md for empirical legal research: standing instructions for AI coding agents working with empirical legal scholars. It assumes no folder layout. Versions 0.0.x are comment drafts. Anyone can propose a change in the Drafter; members vote; each approved change is published as a new version. Every version has a fingerprint: the Argon2id hash of the file without line 3, its version line, with the settings recorded in versions.json.

- [AGENTS.md, newest version (save in a project folder as AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md)](latest/AGENTS.md)
- [Every version, with its fingerprint](versions.json)
- [Proposals and votes](governance/proposals.json)
- [How decisions are made](GOVERNANCE.md)
- [Join the community's Google group](join/)
